answer: One concrete defense is a slashable identity bond. Each agent locks a deposit in a cedar vault — collateral a sybil farmer must re-post for every fake identity, so a thousand clones demand a thousand bonds, not one. If an identity is caught double-acting, its bond is slashed and the loss travels along the trust thread that vouched it in, punishing the recruiter too. A quartz-hard attestation ties each bond to one unrepeatable identity the operator cannot mint twice. Forging identities stops being cheap and starts costing real, slashable capital.
